wrong-law.meaning: Chose a principle that doesn't fit

message.en: This law doesn't link what's given to what's asked.
Check which quantity is conserved here.

suvat-nonuniform.meaning: Used equations of motion with non-constant a

message.en: suvat needs constant acceleration.

unknown-not-eliminated.meaning: Chose an equation that keeps an unknown

message.en: Choose an equation that removes the unknown force.

assumed-symmetry.meaning: Split equally or assumed symmetry that isn't there

message.en: Don't assume an equal share. Calculate it.

misread-interval.meaning: Used the wrong time or distance interval

message.en: Which interval does the question give?
Resolve into components first.
Pick a positive direction and stick to it.
Convert to SI units before calculating.
Check the power: v², ω², r².

wrong-power.meaning: Wrong power (other than a missed square)

message.en: Check how the quantity scales.
Check which goes on top.
Adjacent → cos, opposite → sin.
r is the radius.

forgot-g.meaning: Used mass instead of weight, or dropped g

message.en: Weight = mg.

forgot-mass.meaning: Dropped or used the wrong mass

message.en: Which mass is moving?

forgot-half.meaning: Dropped a ½ (KE, area of a triangle)

message.en: Check the ½.
Split the area into simple shapes.

stopped-early.meaning: Gave a middle step as the answer

message.en: That's a middle step. Carry on to what's asked.

wrong-quantity.meaning: Found a different quantity than asked

message.en: Reread what the question asks for.

ignored-condition.meaning: Missed a condition (smooth, at rest, equal mass)

message.en: Underline the conditions in the question.

missed-true-statement.meaning: Rejected a true statement in a grid

message.en: Check each statement separately.
This one needs learning. It will come back soon.

slope-area-swap.meaning: Confused gradient and area of a graph

message.en: Gradient = rate. Area = accumulation.

boundary.meaning: Wrong about whether limits are included

message.en: Check the end values of the range.

v-zero-at-top.meaning: Thinks the whole velocity is 0 at max height

message.en: Only the vertical part is zero at the top.
Gravity never switches off: a = g the whole time.

force-along-motion.meaning: Thinks motion needs a forward force

message.en: Motion doesn't need a forward force.

motion-vs-accel.meaning: Confuses direction of motion with direction of acceleration

message.en: Acceleration follows the change in velocity, not the motion.

up-down-time.meaning: Thinks up and down times differ, without air resistance

message.en: Without air resistance, up and down times match.
Use total displacement ÷ total time.
Action and reaction act on different bodies.

balance-vs-pair.meaning: Confuses balanced forces with a third-law pair

message.en: A pair acts between the same two bodies.

force-on-wrong-body.meaning: Picks the force acting on the other body

message.en: Ask: which force acts on this body?

internal-force.meaning: Thinks an internal force accelerates the system

message.en: Only external forces change the motion.

friction-direction.meaning: Has friction acting the wrong way

message.en: Friction opposes the sliding that would happen.

normal-vertical.meaning: Draws the normal reaction as always vertical

message.en: N is perpendicular to the surface.

forgot-mu.meaning: Used the full weight as the friction force

message.en: Friction depends on μ. Include it.

centrifugal.meaning: Adds an outward force in circular motion

message.en: Circular motion needs a net inward force.

ke-conserved-inelastic.meaning: Conserves KE in an inelastic collision or explosion

message.en: Momentum is conserved; KE is not.

momentum-external-force.meaning: Conserves momentum while an external force acts

message.en: An external force acts, so momentum changes.
Check if mass cancels out.
Rotating? Use the angular version.
Angular momentum is conserved here, not KE.

moi-depends-on-omega.meaning: Thinks I depends on spin rate

message.en: I depends on where the mass is, not on the speed.

moi-shape-swap.meaning: Swaps which shape has the larger I

message.en: More mass far from the axis gives a larger I.

moi-mass-only.meaning: Thinks equal mass means equal I

message.en: Where the mass sits matters too.

moi-axis-free.meaning: Thinks I doesn't depend on the axis

message.en: I depends on the axis.

pair-unequal.meaning: Thinks the forces of a pair differ in size

message.en: The two forces of a pair are always equal.

pair-delay.meaning: Thinks the reaction comes after the action

message.en: The two forces exist at the same time.
Gravity forms pairs without contact.

pair-wrong-bodies.meaning: Picks a force between other bodies

message.en: A pair involves the same two bodies.

free-fall-reading.meaning: Expects a zero reading without free fall

message.en: The reading is zero only in free fall.

force-wrong-source.meaning: Names a force that can't act that way here

message.en: Ask what force actually points that way.

omitted-friction.meaning: Leaves friction off a block at rest on a slope

message.en: Without friction the block would slide.

ke-half-at-top.meaning: Thinks KE halves at the top for any angle

message.en: KE at the top depends on the angle.

ke-pe-confusion.meaning: Ties KE to PE instead of speed

message.en: KE depends on speed.
Gravity still acts in flight.

speed-constant.meaning: Thinks speed stays constant in flight

message.en: Only the horizontal velocity stays constant.
A straight s–t line means constant velocity.

swapped-support.meaning: Swaps which support takes more load

message.en: Moving towards Q puts more load on Q.

current-used-up.meaning: Thinks current falls along a series circuit

message.en: Current is the same all the way round a series circuit.

series-parallel-swap.meaning: Uses the series rule for parallel, or the reverse

message.en: Check how the components are connected.

meter-placement.meaning: Places an ammeter in parallel or a voltmeter in series

message.en: Ammeters go in series. Voltmeters go in parallel.

emf-vs-terminal-pd.meaning: Ignores the drop across internal resistance

message.en: Terminal pd = E − Ir when current flows.

capacitor-rule-swap.meaning: Uses the resistor combination rule for capacitors

message.en: Capacitors combine the opposite way to resistors.
Field is a vector. Potential is a scalar.

negative-charge-direction.meaning: Forgets a negative charge feels the opposite force

message.en: A negative charge feels the opposite force.

hand-rule-direction.meaning: Misapplies the magnetic force or field rule

message.en: Set out the directions, then apply the rule.

closed-loop-swap.meaning: Confuses electric and magnetic field line shapes

message.en: Only magnetic field lines form closed loops.

celsius-in-gas-law.meaning: Used °C instead of kelvin in a gas law

message.en: Gas laws need the absolute temperature, in kelvin.

forgot-latent.meaning: Left out the heat needed to melt or boil

message.en: Melting or boiling takes heat too: add mL.

heat-during-change.meaning: Thinks the temperature rises while a substance melts or boils

message.en: The temperature stays fixed while it melts or boils.

ice-all-melts.meaning: Assumes all the ice melts without checking

message.en: Check there's enough heat to melt all the ice first.

hole-shrinks.meaning: Thinks a hole in a plate gets smaller when the plate is heated

message.en: A hole expands as if it were made of the plate's metal.

expansion-reading.meaning: Gets the direction of a hot or cold scale's reading error wrong

message.en: A hot scale's marks spread apart, so it reads short.

rh-vs-absolute.meaning: Thinks a higher relative humidity always means more water vapour

message.en: Relative humidity also depends on the temperature.

svp-boyle.meaning: Applies Boyle's law to a saturated vapour

message.en: Saturated vapour pressure doesn't change with volume.

ke-depends-on-gas.meaning: Thinks the mean molecular KE depends on the gas, its pressure or volume

message.en: Mean KE depends only on the absolute temperature.

absolute-zero-myth.meaning: Thinks water freezes, or gases liquefy, at absolute zero

message.en: At 0 K the mean KE of an ideal gas is zero.

isothermal-no-heat.meaning: Thinks no heat flows in an isothermal process

message.en: Isothermal means ΔU = 0, but heat still flows.

adiabatic-constant-t.meaning: Thinks an adiabatic process keeps the temperature constant

message.en: Adiabatic means no heat flows, but the temperature changes.

cooling-constant-rate.meaning: Assumes an object cools at a steady rate

message.en: Cooling slows as the excess temperature falls.

room-temp-excess.meaning: Uses the object's temperature, not its excess over the room

message.en: Newton's law uses the excess over the surroundings.

lagged-linear.meaning: Expects a straight-line temperature fall along an unlagged rod

message.en: An unlagged rod loses heat along it, so the gradient changes.

drift-thin-slower.meaning: Thinks drift speed is the same or lower where the wire is thinner

message.en: Same current through less area: the electrons drift faster.

power-formula-choice.meaning: Uses P = I²R when the voltage is fixed, or V²/R when the current is fixed

message.en: Use the power formula with the quantity that stays fixed.

max-power-efficiency.meaning: Thinks maximum power transfer is also maximum efficiency

message.en: At maximum power, half the power is lost inside the source.

pot-draws-current.meaning: Thinks the cell being tested gives current at balance

message.en: At balance no current flows from the cell being tested.

pot-driver-too-small.meaning: Thinks any driver cell gives a balance point

message.en: The pd across the wire must be larger than the e.m.f. you measure.

meter-resistance.meaning: Wants a high-resistance ammeter or a low-resistance voltmeter

message.en: Ammeters need a tiny resistance. Voltmeters need a huge one.

flux-not-change.meaning: Links the e.m.f. to the flux, not to its rate of change

message.en: E.m.f. depends on how fast the flux changes.

forgot-turns.meaning: Left out the number of turns of a coil

message.en: A coil has N turns: multiply by N.

lenz-opposes-field.meaning: Has the induced current oppose the field, not the change in it

message.en: The induced current opposes the change in flux, not the flux.

lenz-same-direction.meaning: Has the induced current help the change in flux

message.en: If it helped the change, energy would come from nowhere.

transformer-dc.meaning: Thinks a transformer works on steady d.c.

message.en: A transformer needs a changing current.

back-emf-start.meaning: Thinks a motor's back e.m.f. is largest when it starts

message.en: Back e.m.f. grows with the motor's speed.
